Unit 2

What Should You Do?

Get Started · Task A

A:Have a seat, please.
B:Thank you.
A:Would you like some rice?
B:No, thanks.I'm good.
C:Can I have some more soup, please?
A:The food is so good.
B:I'm glad you like it.
A:Could you please pass me the tissues?
B:Here you are.

Close Reading · Task A · What Should You Do?

It's dinner time.
You're at a friend's house.
If you like the food, you can say, "The food is great!"
If you feel full, kindly say, "No, thank you. I'm good."
If you can't get something, ask someone, "Could you please pass me the ...?"
If you drop your spoon on the floor, don't worry.
Pick it up and say, "Excuse me. May I get a new spoon, please?"
At the end of the dinner, always say, "Thank you!"

Unit 3

Cooking Noodles

Get Started · Task A · Cooking Noodles

First, wash the greens.
Next, add some water.
Then, add the noodles.
Then, stir the noodles.
Then, add the greens.
Last, enjoy!

Close Reading · Task A · How to Cook Dumplings

First, add water into a pot.
Wait for the water to boil.
Next, add the dumplings.
Be careful with the hot water!
Then, stir the dumplings with a spoon.
When the dumplings come up to the top, add some cold water.
Wait until they come up again.
Then, take them out.
Remember to turn off the stove!
Time to eat!

Unit 4

Doing Chores

Get Started · Task A · Doing Chores

First, take out the rubbish.
Then, clear the table.
Next, wash the dishes.
Then, put away the dishes.
Then, clean the table.
Last, sweep the floor.

Close Reading · Task A

Aiwen:Lucas, the kitchen looks dirty.How do we clean it up?
Lucas:Well, maybe we can wash the dishes first, and then take the rubbish out.
Aiwen:Our rubbish bin is full.How about we take out the rubbish first?
Lucas:Cool.Then, we can clear the table and wash the dishes next.
Aiwen:Great!We can sweep the floor at the end.Let's get to work.

Jobs and Work Time

Get Started · Task A · Jobs and Work Time

Mr Zhang is a teacher.He works from 8:00 to 16:30.
Ms Zhou is a cook.She works from 6:30 to 15:00.
Mr Fu is a worker.He works from 9:00 to 18:00.
Mr Yuan is a waiter.He works from 14:00 to 22:00.
Mr Gao is an IT worker.He works from 10:00 to 19:00.
Miss Wang is a doctor.She works from 8:00 to 17:00.
Mr Luo is a gardener.He works from 6:00 to 14:00.
Mrs Chen is a cleaner.She works from 9:00 to 16:00.
Mr Wei is a taxi driver.He works from 5:30 to 14:30.
A:Mr Gao is an IT worker.He goes to work at 10 in the morning.He comes home at 7 in the evening.

Close Reading · Task A · Aiwen's Family

My dad is a bus driver.
He usually goes to work at 5 in the morning.
He comes home at 1 in the afternoon.
He gets ready for bed at around 10 o'clock at night.
My mum is a cook.
She goes to work at 5:30 in the morning.
She comes home at 3 in the afternoon.
She goes to bed at 10 at night.
I'm a student, of course.
I get up at 7 and go to school at 7:30 in the morning.
I come home at 4 in the afternoon.
I go to bed at 9 at night.
